senses.ex: Stress can trigger headaches in some people.
senses.exPt: O estresse pode provocar dor de cabeça em algumas pessoas.

senses.def: something that makes a situation or reaction start
senses.ex: The rise in prices was the trigger for the protests.
senses.exPt: O aumento dos preços foi o estopim dos protestos.

senses.def: to cut a small amount off hair, a beard or plants to make them neater
senses.ex: I need to trim my beard before the party.
senses.exPt: Preciso aparar a barba antes da festa.

senses.def: a journey to a place and back again
senses.ex: We took a trip to the mountains last summer.
senses.exPt: Fizemos uma viagem para as montanhas no verão passado.

senses.def: a short visit to a place, often with a group
senses.ex: The kids went on a school trip to the zoo.
senses.exPt: As crianças foram num passeio da escola ao zoológico.

senses.def: a great success or victory
senses.ex: Winning the cup was a great triumph for the team.
senses.exPt: Ganhar a taça foi um grande triunfo para o time.

senses.def: from or typical of the hot parts of the world
senses.ex: Mangoes and pineapples are tropical fruits.
senses.exPt: Manga e abacaxi são frutas tropicais.

senses.def: something that causes difficulty or worry
senses.ex: We had some trouble with the car on the way here.
senses.exPt: Tivemos um problema com o carro no caminho para cá.

senses.def: have trouble doing something: to find it difficult
senses.ex: I have trouble sleeping at night.
senses.exPt: Tenho dificuldade para dormir à noite.

senses.def: in trouble: in a situation where you will be punished
senses.ex: You'll be in trouble if Mum sees this mess.
senses.exPt: Você vai se meter em encrenca se a mãe vir essa bagunça.

senses.def: a piece of clothing that covers each leg separately
senses.ex: I need new trousers for my job interview.
senses.exPt: Preciso de uma calça nova para a entrevista de emprego.

senses.def: a large road vehicle for carrying goods
senses.ex: A big truck was blocking the street.
senses.exPt: Um caminhão grande estava bloqueando a rua.

senses.def: based on facts; not false
senses.ex: Is it true that you're moving to London?
senses.exPt: É verdade que você vai se mudar para Londres?

senses.def: really; used to say that something is completely true
senses.ex: I'm truly sorry for what happened.
senses.exPt: Eu realmente sinto muito pelo que aconteceu.

senses.def: a metal musical instrument that you blow into
senses.ex: He plays the trumpet in the school band.
senses.exPt: Ele toca trompete na banda da escola.

senses.def: to believe that someone is honest and will not hurt you
senses.ex: I trust you because you always tell the truth.
senses.exPt: Confio em você porque você sempre diz a verdade.

senses.def: able to be trusted
senses.ex: I need someone trustworthy to look after my house.
senses.exPt: Preciso de alguém de confiança para cuidar da minha casa.

senses.def: the real facts about something
senses.ex: Please tell me the truth about what happened.
senses.exPt: Por favor, me diga a verdade sobre o que aconteceu.

senses.def: to make an effort to do something
senses.ex: I always try to arrive on time.
senses.exPt: Eu sempre tento chegar na hora.

senses.def: to eat, drink or use something to see if you like it
senses.ex: Try this cake. It's really good!
senses.exPt: Experimenta esse bolo. Está muito bom!

senses.def: an attempt to do something
senses.ex: Good try! You'll get it next time.
senses.exPt: Boa tentativa! Na próxima você consegue.

senses.def: a long thin pipe, or a soft container you squeeze
senses.ex: We need a new tube of toothpaste.
senses.exPt: Precisamos de um tubo novo de pasta de dente.

senses.def: the underground train system in London
senses.ex: It's quicker to take the tube to the museum.
senses.exPt: É mais rápido pegar o metrô para o museu.

senses.def: the day of the week after Monday
senses.ex: The museum is closed on Tuesday.
senses.exPt: O museu fica fechado na terça-feira.

senses.def: to fall suddenly, often rolling over
senses.ex: The little boy tripped and tumbled down the stairs.
senses.exPt: O menininho tropeçou e caiu da escada.

senses.def: to fall quickly in value or amount
senses.ex: Share prices tumbled after the bad news.
senses.exPt: As ações despencaram depois da má notícia.

senses.def: a large sea fish, often sold in cans
senses.ex: I made a tuna sandwich for lunch.
senses.exPt: Fiz um sanduíche de atum para o almoço.

senses.def: a series of musical notes that is nice to hear
senses.ex: She was humming a happy tune.
senses.exPt: Ela estava cantarolando uma melodia alegre.

senses.def: sudden strong movements of air that shake a plane
senses.ex: There was a lot of turbulence during the flight.
senses.exPt: Teve muita turbulência durante o voo.

senses.def: a large bird, or its meat, often eaten at Christmas
senses.ex: We eat turkey at Christmas every year.
senses.exPt: A gente come peru no Natal todo ano.

senses.def: to change direction when you are walking or driving
senses.ex: Turn left at the end of the street.
senses.exPt: Vire à esquerda no fim da rua.

senses.def: the time when someone in a group can or must do something
senses.ex: It's your turn to wash the dishes.
senses.exPt: É a sua vez de lavar a louça.

senses.def: to move something round in a circle
senses.ex: Turn the key slowly to open the door.
senses.exPt: Gire a chave devagar para abrir a porta.

senses.def: a place where a road goes off from the road you are on
senses.ex: Take the second turning on the left after the bridge.
senses.exPt: Pegue a segunda entrada à esquerda depois da ponte.

senses.def: an animal with a hard shell that lives mostly in water
senses.ex: We saw a sea turtle swimming near the beach.
senses.exPt: Vimos uma tartaruga marinha nadando perto da praia.

senses.def: the number 12
senses.ex: There are twelve months in a year.
senses.exPt: O ano tem doze meses.

senses.def: the number 20
senses.ex: There are twenty students in my class.
senses.exPt: Tem vinte alunos na minha turma.

senses.def: two times
senses.ex: I go to the gym twice a week.
senses.exPt: Vou à academia duas vezes por semana.

senses.def: one of two children born to the same mother at the same time
senses.ex: My sister and I are twins.
senses.exPt: Minha irmã e eu somos gêmeas.

senses.def: to hurt a joint by turning it suddenly
senses.ex: I twisted my ankle playing football.
senses.exPt: Torci o tornozelo jogando futebol.

senses.def: to turn something round with your hand
senses.ex: Twist the lid to open the jar.
senses.exPt: Gire a tampa para abrir o pote.

senses.def: an unexpected change in a story or situation
senses.ex: The film has an amazing twist at the end.
senses.exPt: O filme tem uma reviravolta incrível no final.

senses.def: the number 2
senses.ex: We have two children, a boy and a girl.
senses.exPt: Nós temos dois filhos, um menino e uma menina.

senses.def: a group of things that are similar
senses.ex: What type of car do you have?
senses.exPt: Que tipo de carro você tem?

senses.def: to write something using a keyboard
senses.ex: Type your name in the box below.
senses.exPt: Digite seu nome no campo abaixo.

senses.def: having the usual qualities of a particular type
senses.ex: This is a typical Brazilian breakfast.
senses.exPt: Este é um café da manhã típico brasileiro.

senses.def: usually, or in the way that is expected
senses.ex: The trip typically takes about two hours.
senses.exPt: A viagem normalmente leva cerca de duas horas.
